links.outcome: Consultation quality score of ChatGPT-4 versus physicians on the same cases
links.effect: Physician consultation scores were significantly higher than ChatGPT-4 in both obstetric and gynecologic patients; agreement between the two was unacceptable and correlation weak or absent.
links.quote: Paired t tests showed that the scores of physician consultations were significantly higher than those generated by ChatGPT-4 in both obstetric and gynecologic patients.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's performance on retrospective clinical cases compared to human physician consultations using a novel scoring rubric, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
